rankingV6.note: Measured public view counts are primary. Platforms without a stable public count contribute only a low-weight source-presence signal.

notes: Original and arrangement entries stay separate.
Arrangement tracks may reference multiple originalIds.
The client only embeds media when a verified media object exists.
Large-scale ingestion should move arrangement search to Worker/API paging.
Ranking v3 can include verified YouTube, NicoNico and Bilibili view-count signals when available.
Unsupported or unavailable platform view counts are treated as unmeasured rather than fabricated zero-view observations.
Touhou-style fan originals are classified separately from official originals and arrangements.
Touhou-style ranking is category-local and must not change the FULL INDEX denominator used by official/arrangement rankings.
Large Touhou-style collections are stored as compact album manifests and expanded into track objects at client boot.
Mixed albums containing official Touhou source arrangements are excluded from the fan-original catalog unless individual provenance is verified.
Touhou-related entries are included first and separated by relation category instead of being dropped because they are not a standard arrangement.
When an embeddable YouTube match is verified, TouhouDive prefers it for in-app playback while retaining alternate sources as fallbacks.
Touhou-style rankings use measured platform views as the primary signal and YouTube likes/comments as secondary engagement signals.
Touhou-style tracks without measured views or genuine TouhouDB reaction data are not assigned a fabricated zero-view rank.
The curated Touhou-style tab contains only the curated local catalog; generic TouhouDB fan originals remain available through the inclusive all-catalog view.
TouhouDB fan originals and the curated Touhou-style catalog are separate populations in UI, ranking, and coverage statistics.
The fan YouTube matcher also searches TouhouDB fan-original tracks that lack an existing YouTube PV and overlays verified fallback videos without rewriting the source shards.
Per-category media candidates, YouTube candidates, and measured view-track counts are emitted by the full-index build.
The STATION skin is the default presentation and keeps the GRAPH archive skin as a persistent user-selectable alternative.
Home recommendation mixes official originals, derivatives, TouhouDB fan originals, curated Touhou-style tracks, and hidden playable tracks instead of allowing one category to dominate.
The in-app playable filter requires an embeddable provider supported by the TouhouDive player; external-only links no longer count as in-app playable.
User-supplied background artwork is available only in the CUSTOM skin; built-in STATION and GRAPH skins never display it.
Custom artwork is stored locally as a Blob in IndexedDB and is not uploaded by TouhouDive.
CUSTOM background dimming and cover/contain fit settings persist in local storage independently of the image Blob.
User-provided artwork is available only in the CUSTOM skin and is never applied to built-in STATION or GRAPH skins.
Custom background artwork is stored locally in IndexedDB and resized/compressed client-side before persistence; it is not uploaded by TouhouDive.
Every indexed track uses the same ranking-v6 cross-platform source logic when corresponding platform data exists.
Platform direct links are exposed from verified media candidates plus TouhouDB/source links.
SoundCloud, Bandcamp and Piapro presence never fabricates a view count; it contributes only low-weight distribution breadth.
Beginner discovery is a separate recommendation layer and does not alter the canonical all-catalog ranking.
IOSYS tracks receive a strong beginner-accessibility boost while other established circles and iconic official originals are also eligible.
Beginner recommendations prioritize recognizability and immediate playback in addition to popularity.
Beginner circle filters can scan the complete sharded full index instead of depending on whichever tracks have streamed into memory first.
Beginner filters are grouped into recommendation type and circle/doujin/band sections; mobile uses a non-horizontal two-column circle grid.
Circle aliases cover major Touhou doujin circles and bands including IOSYS, Yuuhei Satellite, Shinra-Bansho, COOL&CREATE, SOUND HOLIC and others.
Beginner mode scans the complete full index and keeps a large ranked candidate pool instead of relying on the current mobile streaming cache.
Explicit MV/PV/official-video candidates are strongly prioritized, followed by other YouTube/NicoNico/Bilibili video-linked tracks.
The beginner MV/PV filter restricts the discovery pool to tracks with a video-provider candidate.
